about: Pins the page's score-setting inputs. inputs.test.ts fails when a pinned file changes unless the change is recorded here: date, file, from and to (the sha256 before and after), a reason, the issue or pull request, and signoff_comment, the id of the independent reviewer's comment. Re-pinned on the rename to repo-documentation: inputs.json gained the front door's fields. questions.json stays here because the Code page's checks read it.

changes.reason: The private repository's name leaves the tree before the public launch
